segments.title: Groundwork for EditPokemonPage
context: This change adds an edit page for a Pokemon, with an Edit link to it on the page of each Pokemon. The edit page opens the Pokemon form on the saved name, level, type and trainer, and Save sends the changes to a new update procedure of the API, which writes them to the database and then opens the page of the Pokemon again.

nodes.impactReason: The handler now runs [the `update` procedure](code:src/server/api/routers/pokemon.ts#L20-22) for a `POST` to `/api/trpc/pokemon.update`, a path that matched no procedure before. Any client can send it, as for `pokemon.create`, because both are built on [`publicProcedure`](code:src/server/api/trpc.ts#L11).

`appRouter` now holds [the procedure `update`](code:src/server/api/routers/pokemon.ts#L20-22) under `pokemon`, beside `byId` and `create`. The HTTP handler and both clients built from `appRouter` can now call `pokemon.update`.

waypoints.title: Modified `<PokemonForm />` to edit a saved Pokemon
waypoints.reading:
The author modified the component `<PokemonForm />` so that it edits a saved Pokemon as well as it creates one:

- it takes an optional prop `pokemon` of the Prisma type `Pokemon`
- it gets a second mutation, `update`, beside `create`
- its `action` calls `update.mutate()` when it has a `pokemon`, and `create.mutate()` when it has none
- the name, level and type inputs and the trainer select open on the values of `pokemon`, such as `Pikachu` for the name
- [the Save button shows `Saving…`](code:src/app/_components/SubmitButton.tsx#L4) while either mutation runs

[`<EditPokemonPage />` passes the Pokemon it loaded](code:src/app/pokemon/[id]/edit/page.tsx#L13), so that the edit page and `src/app/pokemon/new/page.tsx` render the same form. The new Pokemon page passes no `pokemon`, so its inputs get `undefined` and stay empty, its select opens on `No trainer`, and a save creates a Pokemon as before.

children.title: Added the mutation `update` for a saved Pokemon
children.reading: The author added a statement that creates the mutation `update` with `api.pokemon.update.useMutation()` of [the React client](code:src/trpc/react.tsx#L10). When [the `update` procedure](code:src/server/api/routers/pokemon.ts#L20-22) returns the updated row, `onSuccess` pushes the page of that Pokemon, such as `/pokemon/3`, so that a save on the edit page opens [the Pokemon page](code:src/app/pokemon/[id]/page.tsx#PokemonPage) on the saved values, as `create` does for a new Pokemon.

children.title: Modified the form action to update a Pokemon the form was given
children.reading:
The author modified the `action` of the form so that it reads the four fields into `fields`, then:

- calls `create.mutate(fields)` when `pokemon` is `undefined`, as on `src/app/pokemon/new/page.tsx`
- calls `update.mutate({ id: 3, ...fields })` for the Pokemon with id 3, as on [the edit page](code:src/app/pokemon/[id]/edit/page.tsx#L13)

A save on the edit page therefore changes that Pokemon and creates no new one. Both calls send the same fields, so [the `update` procedure](code:src/server/api/routers/pokemon.ts#L20-22) validates them with the same `pokemonInput` as `create`, with the `id` added.
children.coreChange: This is the decision the edit page depends on: a form that is given a Pokemon now sends [`pokemon.update`](code:src/server/api/routers/pokemon.ts#L20-22) in place of `pokemon.create`, so a save changes the Pokemon and adds none.

waypoints.title: Added the procedure `update` to `pokemonRouter`
waypoints.reading:
The author added a mutation procedure `update` to the router `pokemonRouter` that:

- validates the input with `pokemonInput`, extended with a numeric `id`
- updates the row of the Pokemon with that `id` to every other field of the input, and returns the updated row

It writes every field it gets, so a professor who picks `No trainer` sets `trainerId` to `null` and the Pokemon has no trainer after the save, because [the form sends `trainerId: null` for `No trainer`](code:src/app/pokemon/_components/PokemonForm.tsx#L28). `appRouter` in `src/server/api/root.ts` serves it at `/api/trpc/pokemon.update`, and [`<PokemonForm />` calls it through `update.mutate()`](code:src/app/pokemon/_components/PokemonForm.tsx#L31), so that a save on the edit page changes the Pokemon in the database.
waypoints.coreChange: This is where a save of the edit page writes to the database: [the `update.mutate()` of the form](code:src/app/pokemon/_components/PokemonForm.tsx#L31) reaches this procedure through `/api/trpc`, and the procedure validates the same fields as `create` before it updates the row.

findings.title: `update` throws `P2025` for a deleted Pokemon, and the form shows nothing
findings.reading: [`ctx.db.pokemon.update()` throws a `PrismaClientKnownRequestError` with the code `P2025`](code:src/server/api/routers/pokemon.ts#L21) when no row has the `id`. The procedure does not catch it, so tRPC sends the client a `TRPCError` with the code `INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR`. [The `update` mutation of the form has no `onError`](code:src/app/pokemon/_components/PokemonForm.tsx#L15-17), and [the form renders no error](code:src/app/pokemon/_components/PokemonForm.tsx#L34-45), so the button shows `Save` again and the professor gets no message that the edits were not saved. No code in this repository deletes a Pokemon and no database runs for it, so only a row deleted outside the app after the edit page opened reaches this, and the error was not reproduced. The fix also needs `TRPCError` from `@trpc/server` and `Prisma` from `@prisma/client` in [the imports](code:src/server/api/routers/pokemon.ts#L1-2), and [the form](code:src/app/pokemon/_components/PokemonForm.tsx#L34-45) has to render `update.error.message` to show the error.
trace: A professor opens `/pokemon/3/edit`, the Pokemon with id 3 is deleted from the database outside the app, and the professor clicks Save.
[`ctx.db.pokemon.update({ where: { id: 3 }, data })`](code:src/server/api/routers/pokemon.ts#L21) → throws `PrismaClientKnownRequestError` with the code `P2025`.
tRPC sends a `TRPCError` with the code `INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR`, and [the mutation](code:src/app/pokemon/_components/PokemonForm.tsx#L15-17) runs no `onSuccess` and has no `onError`.
[`isPending ? "Saving…" : label`](code:src/app/_components/SubmitButton.tsx#L4) → `Save`, and the form renders no message.

segments.title: New EditPokemonPage
context: This segment adds the edit page of a Pokemon, which loads the Pokemon and the trainers on the server and shows the Pokemon form filled with the saved values, so that Save changes that Pokemon and creates no new one. An id that matches no Pokemon shows the 404 page.

traceDiagram.title: Load and save Pokemon flow diagram
traceDiagram.description: This diagram shows how the edit page loads a Pokemon and the trainers through the server caller and renders them in the Pokemon form. It also shows what happens when the user clicks Save, and how the edited Pokemon reaches the database through [the `update` procedure](code:src/server/api/routers/pokemon.ts#L20-22).

traceNodes.label: Loads the Pokemon and the trainers and renders the form
traceNodes.description: When a professor clicks [Edit on the page of a Pokemon](code:src/app/pokemon/[id]/page.tsx#L15-17), Next.js opens `/pokemon/3/edit` and renders this page with `params` that resolve to `{ id: "3" }`. Its calls go through [`api` of `~/trpc/server`](code:src/trpc/server.ts#L7), which `createCaller` builds, so they run each procedure on the server with no request to `/api/trpc`.

waypoints.title: Added the page `<EditPokemonPage />` that edits a saved Pokemon
waypoints.reading:
The author added a page component `<EditPokemonPage />` at `/pokemon/[id]/edit` that:

- loads the Pokemon of the id in the URL with [the `byId` procedure](code:src/server/api/routers/pokemon.ts#L12-14), and renders the 404 page when no Pokemon has that id
- loads the trainers with the `list` procedure of `src/server/api/routers/trainer.ts`
- renders the heading `Edit Pikachu` for a Pokemon named Pikachu
- renders [`<PokemonForm />`](code:src/app/pokemon/_components/PokemonForm.tsx#PokemonForm) with the trainers and the Pokemon

[The Edit link of the Pokemon page opens it](code:src/app/pokemon/[id]/page.tsx#L15-17), so that a professor can change a Pokemon after it is created. Both loads go through [`api` of `~/trpc/server`](code:src/trpc/server.ts#L7), which `createCaller` builds, so they run the procedures on the server with no request to `/api/trpc`.
waypoints.coreChange: This is the page the pull request is named for: it loads a saved Pokemon on the server and hands it to [`<PokemonForm />`](code:src/app/pokemon/_components/PokemonForm.tsx#PokemonForm), which then saves through [`pokemon.update`](code:src/server/api/routers/pokemon.ts#L20-22) in place of creating a Pokemon.

children.title: Added the read of the id from the URL
children.reading: The author added a statement that awaits `params` and reads `id`, such as `"3"` for `/pokemon/3/edit`. `id` is a string, so [the next line passes `Number(id)`](code:src/app/pokemon/[id]/edit/page.tsx#L7) to `byId`, whose input [takes `id` as a `z.number()`](code:src/server/api/routers/pokemon.ts#L12).

children.title: Added the load of the Pokemon through the server caller
children.reading: The author added a call to `api.pokemon.byId({ id: 3 })` for `/pokemon/3/edit`, which runs [the `byId` procedure](code:src/server/api/routers/pokemon.ts#L12-14) in the same process and returns the Pokemon with id 3, or `null` when no row has that id. [The condition below calls `notFound()` for `null`](code:src/app/pokemon/[id]/edit/page.tsx#L8), and [the form gets the Pokemon](code:src/app/pokemon/[id]/edit/page.tsx#L13) for its saved values.

findings.title: `<EditPokemonPage />` passes `NaN` to `byId` and fails before the 404
findings.reading: `Number(id)` returns `NaN` for `/pokemon/abc/edit`. [The input of `byId` takes `id` as a `z.number()`](code:src/server/api/routers/pokemon.ts#L12), and zod 3 returns an `invalid_type` issue for `NaN`, so the server caller throws a `TRPCError` with the code `BAD_REQUEST`. The page then fails with the Next.js error page, and [the condition below](code:src/app/pokemon/[id]/edit/page.tsx#L8) never renders the 404 page. Nothing in this repository runs, so the error was not reproduced. [The Pokemon page reads its id the same way](code:src/app/pokemon/[id]/page.tsx#L7).
trace: [`z.object({ id: z.number() })`](code:src/server/api/routers/pokemon.ts#L12) → `invalid_type`, and the server caller throws a `TRPCError` with the code `BAD_REQUEST`.
findings.solution: const pokemon = /^\d+$/.test(id) ? await api.pokemon.byId({ id: Number(id) }) : null

children.title: Added the 404 for an id that matches no Pokemon
children.reading: The author added a condition that calls `notFound()` when [`byId`](code:src/server/api/routers/pokemon.ts#L12-14) returns `null`. `notFound()` throws, so Next.js renders the 404 page, and the heading and the form render only with a Pokemon. [The Pokemon page has the same condition](code:src/app/pokemon/[id]/page.tsx#L8).

children.title: Added the load of the trainers
children.reading: The author added a call to `api.trainer.list()`, which runs the `list` procedure of `src/server/api/routers/trainer.ts` on the server and returns every trainer ordered by name. [The form renders one option per trainer](code:src/app/pokemon/_components/PokemonForm.tsx#L39-43) in its trainer select, as it does on `src/app/pokemon/new/page.tsx`.

segments.title: Modified PokemonPage
context: This segment adds an Edit link below the level and the type on the page of a Pokemon, which opens the edit page of the same Pokemon.

waypoints.title: Modified `<PokemonPage />` to link to the edit page
waypoints.reading: The author modified the page component `<PokemonPage />` to render an `Edit` link below the level and the type, which points at `/pokemon/3/edit` for the Pokemon with id 3. Next.js renders [`<EditPokemonPage />`](code:src/app/pokemon/[id]/edit/page.tsx#EditPokemonPage) at that path, so that a professor opens the edit form from the page of the Pokemon. [The `update` mutation of the form pushes back to this page](code:src/app/pokemon/_components/PokemonForm.tsx#L16) after a save.
